risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sender Policy Framework (SPF), security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Sender Policy Framework (SPF) (NET-39.2) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Boundary Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor and control communications at the external network boundary and at key internal boundaries within the network.
compensating_control_2.justification: Boundary Protection (NET-03) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Sender Policy Framework (SPF) (NET-39.2) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
